result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but a few visual defects are present: a typo in the search placeholder, a clipped category chip at the right edge beyond the intended carousel behavior, and minor contrast concerns.

issues.description: Search placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: An additional category chip is barely visible at the right edge after 'Healthy' (only a sliver of a gray pill), which looks like a rendering artifact rather than an intentional peek of a scrollable item.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontally scrollable chip row shows a meaningful portion of the next chip (e.g., at least half its width) so the affordance to scroll is clear, or add proper edge padding/fade.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right is a light gray glyph on a light gray circular background, giving low contrast, and the red notification dot has no accessible label or badge count.
issues.suggestion: Darken the bell icon to meet contrast guidelines and add an accessible label/badge (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread').

issues.description: The 'See all' links next to section headers are small green text on a light background; while readable, the tap target appears small for touch interaction.
issues.suggestion: Increase the tap target size of 'See all' links to at least 44x44 pt or add padding around them.
